title: Differentiate agent and human Git identities
description:
## Issue Setup

- UAT Required: No

## Issue Goal

Differentiate agent and human Git identities in prepared workspaces and runtime evidence.

## Why Now

Dogfooding needs commits, logs, and workpads to make the acting identity clear without changing global operator settings.

## Issue Context

Jade Symphony can prepare workspaces and run dry-run backends, but identity metadata is not yet captured consistently.

## Decisions / Assumptions

### Decisions

- Apply configured git identity with local repository config only.
- Record actor role and label in runtime evidence.

### Assumptions

- GitHub API identity remains controlled by authenticated gh credentials until profile-specific auth exists.

## Non-Negotiable Guardrails

- Do not write global git config.
- Do not claim Human Review from main implementation work.
- Do not read or log secrets.

## Scope

### In Scope

- Workflow identity config.
- Local workspace git identity application.
- Runtime state, event log, and workpad identity metadata.
- Fixture verification.

### Out of Scope

- Account manager.
- Token routing.
- Commit signing enforcement.

## Canonical References

### Target Repository / Package

- Alive24/jade-symphony

### Relevant Knowledge Sources

- docs/bootstrap/JADE_WORKFLOW.md
- docs/bootstrap/JADE_SYMPHONY_SPEC.md

### Relevant Code Paths

- src/config.rs
- src/workspace.rs
- src/runtime_state.rs
- src/event_log.rs
- src/main.rs

## Current State

Workspace preparation exists, but git actor identity is implicit.

## Deliverable Shape

A focused identity configuration and local git application slice with tests and docs.

## Risks or Constraints

- Applying identity globally would contaminate the operator environment.

## Expected Outcome

A fixture run shows actor metadata and local git identity evidence.

## Verification

### Completion Criteria

- cargo run -- run-once examples/git-identity-workflow.md prints actor and git identity evidence.

### Functional Verification

- cargo test
- cargo fmt --check
- cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

### UAT

- Not required.

### Context Verification

- Confirm local git config is set only inside the prepared workspace.
